pathSubtitle: Navigate check-in, security, boarding, and flight delays with confidence.

lessons.title: Check-In Desk
lessons.situation: You arrive at the airport and go to the check-in desk.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Good morning. Can I see your passport and booking, please?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course. Here you are.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Thank you. Are you checking any bags today?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Yes, one suitcase.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Please put it on the scale. It's 22 kilograms — that's within the limit. Window or aisle seat?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Window, please.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Here is your boarding pass. Your gate is B14. Boarding starts at 10:30.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Thank you. What time is it now?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: It's 9:15. You have plenty of time.

words.definition: to register your arrival at an airport or hotel
words.example: I need to check in two hours before the flight.

words.definition: a document that allows you to board a plane
words.example: Please have your boarding pass ready.

words.definition: the walkway between seats on a plane
words.example: I prefer an aisle seat for long flights.

words.definition: the specific exit in an airport where you board your plane
words.example: Our gate is C22.

words.definition: the maximum amount allowed
words.example: The baggage limit is 23 kilograms.

lessons.title: Through Security
lessons.situation: You are going through airport security.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Please remove your laptop from your bag and put it in a separate tray.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: OK. Do I need to take off my shoes?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Yes, shoes and belts too, please. And any liquids must be in a clear bag.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I have a small bottle of water — is that OK?

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Sorry, liquids over 100ml are not allowed through. You'll need to throw it away.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course. I understand.

dialogue.speaker: Officer
dialogue.text: Thank you. Please walk through the scanner now.

words.definition: the safety checks at an airport
words.example: The security queue was very long today.

words.definition: a flat container used to carry or place items
words.example: Put your phone in the tray.

words.definition: a substance that flows, like water or juice
words.example: Liquids must be under 100ml.

words.definition: permitted; acceptable
words.example: Large bottles are not allowed through security.

words.definition: a machine that checks what you are carrying
words.example: Walk slowly through the scanner.

lessons.title: Flight Delay
lessons.situation: Your flight has been delayed. You approach the information desk to find out what is happening.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I'm on the 14:30 flight to Dubai — the board says it's delayed. Do you know how long?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: I'm sorry for the inconvenience. There's a technical issue with the aircraft. We're currently estimating a two-hour delay.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Two hours? I have a connecting flight in Dubai at 19:00. Will I make it?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: It's going to be tight. If you miss the connection, the airline will book you on the next available flight at no extra cost.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Is there anything I can do now to speed that process up if needed?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: I'd recommend speaking to the transfer desk in Dubai as soon as you land. They'll have your details on the system.

words.definition: when something happens later than expected
words.example: The flight has a three-hour delay.

words.definition: trouble or difficulty caused to someone
words.example: We apologize for any inconvenience caused.

words.definition: a second flight that continues your journey
words.example: I have a connecting flight in Istanbul.

words.definition: with little time to spare
words.example: The connection is going to be tight.

words.definition: an airport desk that helps passengers with connecting flights
words.example: Go to the transfer desk to rebook your connection.

lessons.title: Lost Luggage
lessons.situation: You have arrived at your destination but your suitcase has not appeared on the baggage belt.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Excuse me. I've been waiting at belt six for forty minutes and my bag still hasn't come through.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: I'm sorry to hear that. Can I take your name, flight number, and a description of the bag?

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: It's a large black suitcase with a red ribbon tied to the handle. Flight was BA207 from London.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Thank you. I can see in our system that your bag was loaded but there may have been a scanning error at the transfer point. It's likely on the next flight, arriving in three hours.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's frustrating. I have a business meeting this evening — my work clothes are in that bag.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: I completely understand. We can offer an emergency allowance of $50 for essential items. Here is the claim form and our tracking number for your file.

words.definition: the moving conveyor where luggage arrives after a flight
words.example: My bag came through on belt three.

words.definition: placed onto a vehicle or aircraft
words.example: All bags were loaded before departure.

words.definition: the airport where bags move from one flight to another
words.example: There was a delay at the transfer point.

words.definition: an amount of money or items that is officially permitted
words.example: We received a $50 emergency allowance.

words.definition: a document you complete to request compensation
words.example: Please fill in this claim form for your lost bag.

lessons.title: Upgrade & Premium Travel
lessons.situation: You are at the check-in desk and politely ask about the possibility of an upgrade.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Good morning. Passport and booking reference, please.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Of course. I was wondering — is there any availability in business class today? I'm a frequent flyer with Gold status.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Let me check. You're in luck — we do have one seat remaining in business class. As a Gold member, you're eligible for a complimentary upgrade subject to availability, which it appears we have.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: That's wonderful. I have a long-haul flight and I'd genuinely appreciate it.

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Absolutely. I'll reassign your seat. You'll also have access to the premium lounge — it's past security on the left, beside gate A4.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: Perfect. Is there anything else I should be aware of for the premium cabin?

dialogue.speaker: Agent
dialogue.text: Boarding for business class begins 15 minutes before the general boarding call. You'll have priority disembarkation on arrival as well.

words.definition: a passenger who travels often and earns loyalty rewards
words.example: As a frequent flyer, she always gets priority boarding.

words.definition: given free of charge as a courtesy
words.example: The hotel offered a complimentary breakfast.

words.definition: having the right or qualification for something
words.example: You are eligible for a free upgrade.

words.definition: a comfortable waiting area at an airport for premium passengers
words.example: Business class passengers can use the lounge.

words.definition: the process of leaving an aircraft after landing
words.example: Priority disembarkation means you exit first.
